query:
SELECT DISTINCT f.id
        FROM forms f
        JOIN entity_access ea ON ea.entity_id = f.id AND ea.entity_type = 'form'
        WHERE f.database_id = $1
        AND f.trashed_at IS NULL
        AND ea.source_id = ANY($2)
        AND ea.access_level IN ('edit', 'owner')
        ORDER BY f.id
